generation.scope: The normalized three-color Walsh presentation space is an irreducible threefold. Its geometric generic point is standard, has opposite rank sixteen and period two. The generic unmarked quotient is the simultaneous S3 quotient of the double cover of the signed row-column plane branched at the six off-diagonal hyperplanes. All regular lower ranks specialize from this generic point. Every three-color candidate has a Frobenius quadratic dual with Hilbert vector 14641, given by killing the four missing-color words. Its letter annihilators are principal, and every regular Walsh window has period dividing two.

open_mathematics: Analyze the four missing-color quadratics and the rank of the signed matrix N. Detect the rank-one failure at degree four and determine the induced commutation on the rank-two stratum. AS membership at all closed Walsh rank-sixteen points and the coverage outside Walsh bases remain open.
